description: Textbook OHLC drawings of the 61 TA-Lib candlestick patterns, one per direction each can fire in. Every template makes TA-Lib emit expected_value on its last bar; tests/test_candle_pattern_templates.py re-checks that. Built by scripts/build_candle_pattern_templates.py.

candle_captions: Long up candle drives price to a fresh high
First black crow gaps up and opens even higher, but sellers push it back down
Second black crow opens lower still and claws deep back into the first candle's body
templates.reading: Two black crows open progressively lower after a strong rally and drag price back down into the first candle's real body — buyers who chased the highs are underwater, and sellers are now in control.

candle_captions: up candle capping the advance
first long down candle opens inside the up body and closes near its low
second long down candle opens inside the first and closes at a new low
third long down candle opens inside the second and closes at a lower low again
templates.reading: Three down candles in a row, each opening inside the last and closing near its own low — steady, relentless selling with no bounce attempts, right after a mature advance.

candle_captions: Long up candle extends the uptrend
Small candle sits entirely inside the prior body — the rally stalls
Down candle breaks below the first candle's open, confirming the reversal
templates.reading: The harami in the middle shows buying pressure drying up; the third candle closing below the first candle's open confirms sellers have taken control — a bearish three-inside-down.

candle_captions: Long down candle presses price sharply lower
Small candle tucks entirely inside the prior body — selling pressure stalls
Strong up candle breaks back above the first candle's open, confirming the reversal
templates.reading: The tiny middle candle (a harami) shows the down-move running out of steam; the third candle's close above the first candle's open confirms buyers have taken control — a bullish three-inside-up.

candle_captions: down candle extending the decline
second down candle opens near the first's body and closes lower
third down candle opens near the second's body and closes lower again
one large up candle opens below the third close and closes above the first candle's open, erasing all three declines
templates.reading: Three falling black crows get engulfed by a single up candle that wipes out the entire three-bar loss in one move — but as a continuation pattern this is a violent shakeout inside a down-trend, not a reversal.

candle_captions: up candle advancing the trend
second up candle opens near the first's body and closes higher
third up candle opens near the second's body and closes higher again
one large down candle opens above the third close and closes below the first candle's open, erasing all three advances
templates.reading: Three rising white soldiers get engulfed by a single down candle that wipes out the entire three-bar gain in one move — but as a continuation pattern this is a violent shakeout inside an up-trend, not a reversal.

candle_captions: Up candle continues the rally
Down candle fully engulfs the prior up body, opening above and closing below it
Third candle closes even lower, confirming the reversal
templates.reading: The engulfing down candle swallows the entire prior up body, and the third candle's lower close confirms sellers have wrestled control away from the uptrend — a bearish three-outside-down.

candle_captions: Down candle continues the slide
Up candle fully engulfs the prior down body, opening below and closing above it
Third candle closes even higher, confirming the reversal
templates.reading: The engulfing up candle swallows the entire prior down body in one move, and the third candle's higher close confirms the bulls have wrestled control away from the downtrend — a bullish three-outside-up.

candle_captions: Long down candle with a deep lower tail — sellers push hard but buyers defend the lows
Smaller down candle opens higher, dips into but not below the first candle's tail, and closes off its own low
Tiny down marubozu with almost no shadows, fully contained inside the second candle's range — selling pressure has all but vanished
templates.reading: Each candle's range and lower shadow shrink in turn even as the color stays down — the selling is losing momentum bar by bar, a quiet bottoming signature that shows up after a decline.

candle_captions: Solid up candle with almost no upper shadow — buyers close near the high
Second up candle opens inside the first body and marches to a new, similarly-sized high
Third up candle opens inside the second body and again closes strongly near its high
templates.reading: Three steady, similarly-sized up candles each open within the prior body and close higher with barely any upper wick — a textbook, unhesitating advance after a downtrend.

candle_captions: Long up candle extends the rally
Tiny doji gaps straight up, completely isolated from the prior candle's shadow
Down candle gaps back down, isolated from the doji, and closes well back inside the first candle's body
templates.reading: The doji sits on an island at the top, with a full gap on both sides — the market is abandoned as sellers gap back below it and claw deep into the first candle's body.

candle_captions: Long down candle extends the decline
Tiny doji gaps straight down, completely isolated from the prior candle's shadow
Up candle gaps back up, isolated from the doji, and closes well back inside the first candle's body
templates.reading: The doji sits on an island, with a full gap (shadow-to-shadow) on both sides — a classic exhaustion candle that gets abandoned as buyers gap back above it and reclaim the first candle's body.

candle_captions: Long up candle with a tiny upper shadow — a confident rally leg
Second up candle opens inside the first body and closes higher, but its body is smaller and it now carries a visible upper wick — the advance is losing its edge
Third up candle opens inside the second body and closes higher still, but its body is smaller again with an even longer upper wick
templates.reading: Each up candle closes higher, so on price alone it still looks like an uptrend — but the bodies are shrinking and the upper wicks are growing, meaning buyers are pushing but sellers are pushing back harder each bar. The rally is running out of steam.

candle_captions: After five straight up bars, price opens exactly at the high with no upper wick and drops 2.6 points to close near the bottom.
templates.reading: Buyers had been in control for five bars, but this bar opens at its high with no follow-through and sellers take it the rest of the way down. It is the bearish mirror of the belt-hold, at the top of a rally instead of the bottom of a slide.

candle_captions: After five straight down bars, price opens exactly at the low with no lower wick and climbs 2.6 points to close near the top.
templates.reading: Sellers had been in control for five bars, but this bar opens at its low and buyers take it the rest of the way up. A belt-hold at the bottom of a slide is buyers taking over from the opening bell. Nison reads it as more significant after a decline, though TA-Lib's own test checks only the shape.

candle_captions: long up candle driving the rally
up candle gaps up away from it
up candle pushes to a higher high and higher low
up candle pushes to an even higher high and higher low
a long down candle drops from the high and closes inside the gap left between the first two candles
templates.reading: Four up candles walk steadily higher after a gap up, then one down candle drops back into that gap: buyers have lost their grip and the rally is breaking back down.

candle_captions: long down candle driving the decline
down candle gaps down away from it
down candle pushes to a lower high and lower low
down candle pushes to an even lower high and lower low
a long up candle rallies from the low and closes inside the gap left between the first two candles
templates.reading: Four down candles walk steadily lower after a gap down, then one up candle rallies back into that gap: sellers have lost their grip and the decline is breaking back up.

candle_captions: A long down body that closes exactly at the bar's low, with only a small wick at the open end.
templates.reading: Sellers drove it all the way into the close with no bounce at the end of the bar. The close sitting exactly at the low is the sign of strength. It is the bearish mirror of the up closing marubozu.

candle_captions: A long up body that closes exactly at the bar's high, with only a small wick at the open end.
templates.reading: Buyers drove it all the way into the close with no pullback at the end of the bar. The close sitting exactly at the high is the sign of strength; the small wick at the open end shows sellers got one small push in early.

candle_captions: down marubozu, virtually no wicks, straight down
second down marubozu, again almost no wicks, continuing straight down
down candle gaps down but this time has a real upper wick poking back up into the prior candle's body
down candle that engulfs the third candle entirely, high and low both, and still closes lower
templates.reading: Even though every candle here is down, the third candle's upper wick pokes back into the prior body — a hidden sign buyers tried to fight back — right as the fourth candle swallows it whole; concealed strength inside a downtrend that should turn soon.

candle_captions: long up candle continues the rally
equally long down candle opens far above, then slides back to exactly the same close
templates.reading: After the rally, sellers answer a full-size up candle with a full-size down candle that closes at the same price. The buying has been met head-on and stopped.

candle_captions: long down candle continues the downtrend
equally long up candle opens far below, then rallies back to exactly the same close
templates.reading: After the decline, buyers answer a full-size down candle with a full-size up candle that closes at the same price. The selling has been met head-on and stopped.

candle_captions: long up candle pushes the rally to a new high
down candle opens above the prior high, then closes below the middle of the prior up body
templates.reading: Buyers open the session at a new high, but sellers take it back and close well into yesterday's gain, below its halfway point. The rally has lost control.

candle_captions: After an ordinary sideways stretch, the open and close land almost on top of each other: the real body is barely thicker than a line.
templates.reading: Buyers pushed it up, sellers pushed it back down, and it closed almost exactly where it opened. Neither side could hold any ground, so it is a standoff.

candle_captions: long up candle continues the rally
a doji with short wicks gaps up completely above the prior candle; it opens and closes at almost the same price
templates.reading: The rally gaps to a fresh high and then stalls: the doji shows buyers and sellers now evenly matched. After a rise, that indecision is a warning that the buying may be over.

candle_captions: long down candle continues the slide
a doji with short wicks gaps down completely below the prior candle; it opens and closes at almost the same price
templates.reading: The decline gaps to a fresh low and then stalls: the doji shows buyers and sellers now evenly matched. After a drop, that indecision is a warning that the selling may be over.

candle_captions: Sells off hard during the bar, then buyers bring it all the way back to the open. The result is a long lower wick, almost no upper wick, and a doji body sitting at the top.
templates.reading: Sellers controlled most of the bar and drove price down 2.8 points, but buyers absorbed all of it and closed the bar back at its high. Sellers lost that fight.

candle_captions: modest up candle continues the rally
large down candle opens above the prior high and closes below the prior open, fully engulfing it
templates.reading: Sellers overwhelm the whole prior candle in one bar; the last session's buying is erased and then some.

candle_captions: modest down candle continues the decline
large up candle opens below the prior low and closes above the prior open, fully engulfing it
templates.reading: Buyers overwhelm the whole prior candle in one bar; the last session's selling is erased and then some.

candle_captions: Long up candle drives the rally to a new high
Tiny doji gaps up above the first candle's body — indecision at the top
Down candle gaps down from the doji and closes deep into the first candle's body
templates.reading: The doji marks the exact moment buying exhausted itself; the third candle's plunge back into the first candle's body confirms sellers have taken over — a textbook evening doji star top.

candle_captions: Long up candle drives the rally to a new high
Small-bodied star gaps up above the first candle's body — momentum stalls
Down candle closes deep into the first candle's body, well past the midpoint
templates.reading: The small star candle marks the pause at the top of the rally, and the third candle's deep close back into the first candle's body confirms the reversal — an evening star top.

candle_captions: Down candle continues the decline
Price gaps down and an up candle forms, but the gap holds
Another similarly-sized up candle opens at nearly the same price as the last one, still not filling the gap
templates.reading: Two matching up candles sit side by side just below the gap — the bounce fails to close the gap, so the downtrend is expected to resume once this pause ends.

candle_captions: Up candle advances with the uptrend
Price gaps up and a similarly-sized up candle continues higher
Another up candle of the same size opens at nearly the same price as the last one, holding the gap
templates.reading: Two matching up candles sit side by side just above the gap without filling it back in — a pause that refuels the uptrend rather than reverses it, a bullish continuation.

candle_captions: Rallies hard during the bar, then gives it all back and closes at the open. The result is a long upper wick, almost no lower wick, and a doji body sitting at the bottom.
templates.reading: Buyers pushed it up 2.8 points but could not hold any of the gain, and it closed back at the low. Sellers took the whole rally back.

candle_captions: The fifth straight down bar, closing near its low.
A small body forms at the prior bar's low, with almost no upper wick and a lower wick reaching 1.55 points below it: a textbook hammer.
templates.reading: After a clean slide, sellers try to push it even lower during the bar, but buyers step in hard, absorb the whole move, and close it back at the top of a tiny body. The long lower wick shows sellers ran out of steam right at the low.

candle_captions: The fifth straight up bar, closing near its high.
A small body forms at the prior bar's high, with almost no upper wick and a lower wick reaching 1.55 points below it. It is the same shape as a hammer, but it comes after a rally.
templates.reading: After a clean rally, sellers push it down 1.55 points during the bar before buyers pull the close back up near the top of the bar. The long lower wick that reads as bullish at a bottom is a warning at the top: sellers found real footing for the first time.

candle_captions: long up candle continues the rally
small candle whose whole body sits inside the prior candle's body; momentum has stalled
templates.reading: The long rally suddenly shrinks into a small range that sits entirely inside the prior body. Buyers have run out of conviction.

candle_captions: long down candle continues the slide
small candle whose whole body sits inside the prior candle's body; momentum has stalled
templates.reading: The long decline suddenly shrinks into a small range that sits entirely inside the prior body. Sellers have run out of conviction.

candle_captions: long up candle continues the rally
a doji (open equals close, short wicks both ways) sits wholly inside the prior candle's body
templates.reading: The long rally collapses into a doji inside the prior body: complete indecision right after a strong advance. It is a stronger stall signal than a plain harami.

candle_captions: long down candle continues the slide
a doji (open equals close, short wicks both ways) sits wholly inside the prior candle's body
templates.reading: The long decline collapses into a doji inside the prior body: complete indecision right after a strong sell-off. It is a stronger stall signal than a plain harami.

candle_captions: A small down body sits mid-range, with a wick reaching 2.9 points above it and another 2.8 points below. Both wicks dwarf the tiny body.
templates.reading: The same hard two-way whip as the up version, just closing slightly below the open. What defines this candle is the extreme wicks on both sides, not the colour of its small body.

candle_captions: A small up body sits mid-range, with a wick reaching 2.9 points above it and another 2.8 points below. Both wicks dwarf the tiny body.
templates.reading: Price whipped hard in both directions during the bar while the body barely moved. It is a high-volatility tug-of-war with no winner. TA-Lib's own comment says the sign only encodes the candle's colour, not a bullish or bearish bias.

candle_captions: a wide candle sets the range
a small inside candle forms entirely within the first candle's high-low range
the next candle pokes out the top of the inside bar, a higher high and a higher low: the false breakout
templates.reading: The inside bar coils the range and this candle breaks it to the upside, but the hikkake reads that break as a trap: buyers who chase it get caught, and a close back below the inside bar's low confirms the turn down.

candle_captions: a wide candle sets the range
a small inside candle forms entirely within the first candle's high-low range
the next candle slips out the bottom of the inside bar, a lower high and a lower low: the false breakdown
templates.reading: The inside bar coils the range and this candle breaks it to the downside, but the hikkake reads that break as a trap: sellers who chase it get caught, and a close back above the inside bar's high confirms the turn up.

candle_captions: a wide candle sets the range
an inside candle forms within the first candle's range, and closes right near its own high
a second, tighter inside candle forms within that one
the next candle pokes out the top of the second inside bar, a higher high and a higher low: the false breakout
templates.reading: After a rally, two nested inside bars coil the range (the middle one closing at its high), then price pokes above: a false breakout that tends to trap late buyers before price turns down.

candle_captions: a wide candle sets the range
an inside candle forms within the first candle's range, and closes right near its own low
a second, tighter inside candle forms within that one
the next candle slips out the bottom of the second inside bar, a lower high and a lower low: the false breakdown
templates.reading: After a decline, two nested inside bars coil the range (the middle one closing at its low), then price slips below: a false breakdown that tends to trap late sellers before price turns up.

candle_captions: long down candle continues the slide
small down candle opens and closes entirely inside the prior candle's body: still falling, but barely moving
templates.reading: Even the sellers' own follow-through candle cannot get outside the prior body. The decline is running out of fuel.

candle_captions: Down candle opens at the prior close and marches straight down with almost no lower shadow
Second down candle opens right at the first candle's close and again closes near its own low
Third down candle opens right at the second candle's close and again closes near its own low
templates.reading: Three near-identical down candles stair-step down, each opening exactly where the last one closed with essentially no lower tail — steady, uninterrupted selling with no attempt by buyers to push back, typically seen after an extended advance.

candle_captions: long down candle drives the downtrend
up candle opens below the prior low and closes just a hair above the prior close, barely inside its body
templates.reading: Buyers push a gap-down open back up to yesterday's close, but only just, getting a hair into the prior body. Sellers stay in control.

candle_captions: The fifth straight down bar, closing near its low.
Its body gaps down below the prior bar's body. A small body sits at the bottom of the bar, with a long upper wick reaching 1.55 points above it.
templates.reading: It opens below the slide's last close. Buyers push it sharply higher during the bar before it sinks back to close near its low. The long upper wick shows buyers testing higher ground for the first time, an early hint that the bottom is near even though the close stays low.

candle_captions: up candle with no wicks: opens at its low and closes at its high
down candle with no wicks gaps down under the entire prior candle, opening at its high and closing at its low
templates.reading: An up bar with no wicks is followed by a gap into a down bar with no wicks. Control reverses violently and completely, with no hesitation on either side.

candle_captions: down candle with no wicks: opens at its high and closes at its low
up candle with no wicks gaps up over the entire prior candle, opening at its low and closing at its high
templates.reading: A down bar with no wicks is followed by a gap into an up bar with no wicks. Control reverses violently and completely, with no hesitation on either side.

candle_captions: shorter up candle with no wicks
longer down candle with no wicks gaps down under the entire prior candle; it is the bigger of the two bodies, so it sets the signal's direction
templates.reading: Both bars have no wicks and are separated by a gap, but the second, longer down body dominates and decides the signal: bearish.

candle_captions: shorter down candle with no wicks
longer up candle with no wicks gaps up over the entire prior candle; it is the bigger of the two bodies, so it sets the signal's direction
templates.reading: Both bars have no wicks and are separated by a gap, but the second, longer up body dominates and decides the signal: bullish.

candle_captions: long down candle continuing the decline
long down candle opens lower and closes lower
long down candle opens lower and closes lower again: three rungs down the ladder
a fourth down candle with a real upper wick: buyers pushed up during the bar before sellers closed it low
an up candle opens above the fourth candle's body and closes above its high
templates.reading: Three long down candles march steadily lower, the fourth's upper wick is the first sign of buyers fighting back, and the fifth, an up candle that clears the fourth's high, ends the decline.

candle_captions: A doji body with long wicks on both sides: price swings about 1.8 points up and 1.8 points down, then settles back at the open.
templates.reading: Both buyers and sellers made a real push during the bar and neither could keep it. It is a stalemate with unusually long legs on both sides.

candle_captions: Opens right at the prior close, then a long down body drops 3 points with only thin wicks at the top and bottom. Almost the whole range of the bar is body.
templates.reading: Sellers controlled the bar from open to close with barely any pushback. It is a decisive, high-conviction selling bar.

candle_captions: Opens right at the prior close, then a long up body climbs 3 points with only thin wicks at the top and bottom. Almost the whole range of the bar is body.
templates.reading: Buyers controlled the bar from open to close with barely any pushback. It is a decisive, high-conviction buying bar.

candle_captions: A down body with no wicks at either end: the open is the exact high and the close is the exact low.
templates.reading: Sellers were in complete control from the first tick to the last, and buyers never managed a single push back. It is the bearish mirror of the up marubozu.

candle_captions: An up body with no wicks at either end: the open is the exact low and the close is the exact high.
templates.reading: Buyers were in complete control from the first tick to the last, and sellers never managed a single push back. A candle does not get much more one-sided than this.

candle_captions: down candle sets a new closing low
a second down candle sells off again but closes at exactly the same low, refusing to go further
templates.reading: Two down candles close at the identical low. The floor has been tested twice and held, a bullish double-bottom signal.

candle_captions: long up candle driving the rally
small down candle gaps up above it
small down candle drifts slightly lower, still holding inside the first candle's body
small down candle drifts lower again, still holding inside the first candle's body
up candle opens above the prior close and closes above the highest high of the three small candles, resuming the rally
templates.reading: Three small candles drift gently down but never give back more than half of the first big candle's gain — a shallow rest stop — before the fifth candle powers to a new high and the up-trend holds.

candle_captions: Long down candle extends the decline
Tiny doji gaps down below the first candle's body — indecision at the bottom
Up candle gaps up from the doji and closes deep into the first candle's body
templates.reading: The doji marks the moment selling exhausted itself; the third candle's rally back into the first candle's body confirms buyers have taken over — a textbook morning doji star bottom.

candle_captions: Long down candle extends the decline
Small-bodied star gaps down below the first candle's body — momentum stalls
Up candle closes deep into the first candle's body, well past the midpoint
templates.reading: The small star candle marks the pause at the bottom of the decline, and the third candle's deep close back into the first candle's body confirms the reversal — an evening star top's mirror, a morning star bottom.

candle_captions: long down candle drives the downtrend
up candle opens below the prior low but only manages to close back at that same low
templates.reading: The bounce only gets back to yesterday's low before stalling. It reclaims none of the prior candle's body, so the downtrend continues.

candle_captions: long down candle drives the downtrend
long up candle opens below the prior low, then rallies to close more than halfway back up the prior body
templates.reading: Sellers open the session at a fresh low, but buyers take over and win back more than half of yesterday's loss. A strong bullish reversal.

candle_captions: The same long-legged doji shape, but the tiny body sits exactly halfway between the bar's high and its low.
templates.reading: Neither buyers nor sellers gained any ground, and the body sits in the exact middle of a wide range. It is the clearest picture of a completely undecided market.

candle_captions: long down candle driving the decline
small up candle bounces back, staying inside the first candle's range
small up candle bounces further, still inside the first candle's range
small up candle bounces further still, still inside the first candle's range
long down candle opens below the last bounce close and closes below the first candle's close, resuming the decline
templates.reading: Three small up candles rest inside the first big candle's range without breaking it, then a second long down candle pushes to a fresh low — the down-trend takes a breather and keeps falling.

candle_captions: long up candle driving the rally
small down candle pulls back, staying inside the first candle's range
small down candle pulls back further, still inside the first candle's range
small down candle pulls back further still, still inside the first candle's range
long up candle opens above the last pullback close and closes above the first candle's close, resuming the rally
templates.reading: Three small down candles rest inside the first big candle's range without breaking it, then a second long up candle pushes to a fresh high — the up-trend takes a breather and keeps climbing.

candle_captions: up candle bounces against the downtrend
long down candle opens at exactly the up candle's opening price, with no upper wick, and drives straight down
templates.reading: The second candle opens at the same price as the bounce candle, then falls straight down with no push above. The bounce is rejected and the downtrend resumes.

candle_captions: down candle pulls back against the uptrend
long up candle opens at exactly the down candle's opening price, with no lower wick, and drives straight up
templates.reading: The second candle opens at the same price as the pullback candle, then runs straight up with no dip below. The pullback is rejected and the uptrend resumes.

candle_captions: The fifth straight up bar, closing near its high.
Its body gaps up above the prior bar's body. A small body sits at the bottom of the bar, with a long upper wick reaching 1.55 points above it.
templates.reading: It opens above the rally's last close and pushes to a new high, but sellers knock it back during the bar and it closes near its low. The long upper wick shows buyers were rejected hard right after making a new high, the mirror image of the inverted hammer at a top.

candle_captions: A small down body with only tiny wicks on either side: a quiet bar with a narrow range.
templates.reading: The same quiet, contained bar as the up version, just closing slightly lower. The range is narrow and conviction is low.

candle_captions: A small up body with only tiny wicks on either side: a quiet bar with a narrow range.
templates.reading: This bar barely traded outside its own body. It has a small range and little conviction either way, so it is a lull rather than a signal.

candle_captions: A small down body with an upper wick and a lower wick that are each longer than the body itself.
templates.reading: The same push and pull as the up version, just closing slightly below the open. A small body with real wicks on both sides reads as indecision either way.

candle_captions: A small up body with an upper wick and a lower wick that are each longer than the body itself.
templates.reading: Both sides pushed price around during the bar, but neither could carry the close far. A small real body with real wicks on both sides means hesitation is setting in.

candle_captions: Long up candle with a tiny upper shadow — a strong rally leg
Second long up candle opens inside the first body and closes well higher, with almost no upper shadow
Small up candle opens right at the top of the second candle and barely advances, 'riding the shoulder' of the prior candle
templates.reading: Two strong up candles in a row look bullish, but the third candle's tiny body perched high on the second candle's shoulder shows the buying has run dry — the rally has stalled even though the color never turned.

candle_captions: Down candle closes near the low of the move
Up candle trades entirely above the first candle's close, pushing higher
Down candle sells back off and closes at exactly the same price as the first candle's close
templates.reading: The first and third closes line up exactly, sandwiching a rally attempt in between — that matching floor shows buyers stepping in at the same price twice, a support level sellers can't break, typically seen after a decline.

candle_captions: After five straight down bars, a doji forms with almost no upper wick and a lower wick reaching about 4.8 points below the body.
templates.reading: Sellers drove it about 4.8 points below the open during the bar, but buyers came in hard and dragged it back to a doji close at the top of the range. After a clean slide, that is the first real sign sellers are running out of room. Nison reads a takuri as bullish after a downtrend, even though TA-Lib's own output is undirected.

candle_captions: down candle continuing the slide
a second down candle gaps down and away from it, opening a clean price gap
an up candle opens back inside the second candle's body and closes up into the gap, but the gap itself stays uncrossed
templates.reading: Sellers left a gap open and this bounce candle fails to close it — the down-move is still intact, just pausing.

candle_captions: up candle continuing the rally
a second up candle gaps up and away from it, opening a clean price gap
a down candle opens back inside the second candle's body and closes down into the gap, but the gap itself stays uncrossed
templates.reading: Buyers left a gap open and this pullback candle fails to close it — the up-move is still intact, just pausing.

candle_captions: long down candle drives the downtrend
up candle opens below the prior low, then closes back inside the prior body but stays below its midpoint
templates.reading: Buyers open below yesterday's low and push back into the prior candle's body, but fall short of the halfway mark. That is not enough to reverse the trend, so the decline is expected to continue.

candle_captions: a doji at the top of the rally: open and close almost equal, short wicks both ways
a second doji gaps up clear above the first, wicks and all
a third doji drops back below the second, leaving it stranded alone at the top
templates.reading: Three dojis in a row say buyers can no longer push price anywhere, and the middle one left stranded above the others marks the top: a warning the rally is turning down.

candle_captions: a doji at the bottom of the slide: open and close almost equal, short wicks both ways
a second doji gaps down clear below the first, wicks and all
a third doji climbs back above the second, leaving it stranded alone at the bottom
templates.reading: Three dojis in a row say sellers can no longer push price anywhere, and the middle one left stranded below the others marks the bottom: a warning the slide is turning up.

candle_captions: long down candle driving the decline
a small down candle sits inside the first body, but its long lower wick stabs to a new low
a small up candle opens above that new low and stays below the second candle's close
templates.reading: Sellers pushed to a fresh low on the second candle but could not hold it, and the quiet small up candle that follows shows the selling has run out of force: a bottom is forming.

candle_captions: long up candle extending the rally
a small down candle gaps up above it, floating in open air
a second down candle opens even higher but swallows the small one's body, closing back down though still above the long up candle's close
templates.reading: Two black crows appear after the gap up but can't drag price back into the long up candle's body yet — a warning that buyers have lost control even though the gap itself is intact.

candle_captions: down candle extending the decline
a second down candle gaps down and extends the move further
an up candle opens inside the second candle's body and closes back up inside the first candle's body, filling the gap without reversing it
templates.reading: The bounce candle fills the gap but stays contained inside the first candle's range — the down-trend's gap is being digested, not reversed.

candle_captions: up candle advancing the trend
a second up candle gaps up and extends the move further
a down candle opens inside the second candle's body and closes back down inside the first candle's body, filling the gap without reversing it
templates.reading: The pullback candle fills the gap but stays contained inside the first candle's range — the up-trend's gap is being digested, not reversed.
